verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
May our praise arise as incense
O Lord to You
May our worship be a fragrance
O Lord to You

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
We will seek You first Lord
You will hear our voices
Early in the morning
And late in the night
We will sing Your praises
Giving You the glory
Offering our lives to You
A holy sacrifice

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Help us seek You first Lord
You will hear our voices
Early in the morning
And late in the night
Help us sing Your praises
Giving You the glory
Offering our lives to You
A holy sacrifice
